name: Night Vision
author: Trance
description: Through a pair of night-vision goggles: hills of the spectrum come on out of the dark in green points, the bass lifting them, and a few moths cross in front. The tube's grain hisses with the cymbals.
shade:
e = max(smoothstep(0.74, 0.66, length(x - 0.5, y)), smoothstep(0.74, 0.66, length(x + 0.5, y)))
r = r*e + 0.01*e
g = g*e + 0.035*e
b = b*e + 0.01*e
